about: Office renovation price per m²: what it is made of

The base rate is from $350 per m²: it covers works and rough materials — demolition, partitions, screed, plaster, electrics, low voltage, installation of MEP. This is the foundation without which an office will not work, so we price it first.

Finishing materials, furniture, light fittings and equipment are priced separately, per estimate: this is where the budget depends most on your decisions. Indicatively, 100 m² × $350; 200 m² × $350 or 400 m² × $350 gives the base for the works; the exact total comes after the survey.
Open space or private offices: how the layout affects the estimate

An open space is usually simpler to build: fewer partitions and doors. But it needs more attention to acoustics, lighting and network at every workstation. A cellular layout adds partitions, doors, separate lighting and ventilation lines.
Renovation in a business centre: what is added

In a rented office part of the requirements comes from the building: design approval, connection to the business centre's engineering, fire alarm, hours for noisy works, material deliveries and waste removal. We collect these conditions before pricing so they are in the estimate and schedule, not a surprise.
We prepare an itemised estimate before the works start. If CAS carries out the renovation to our design, the total stays within ±5% of the estimate; additional works only after your written approval.

Timeline and schedule are fixed in the contract — from 2 weeks depending on area and scope. Payment on a schedule that suits you: 50/50, 50/30/20, 50/40/10 or by stages, starting from a 10% advance. Invoicing for companies registered in Ukraine, closing documents. The survey is paid, its cost is individual; a phone consultation is free.
